name: Line Up
designNote: Teaches the flip. Step Sol out of line, let the Tarnish close in, then step back into line: it falls asleep beside Sol, and Lune's Tarnish wakes and walks straight into her pit, filling it.
hints: Step Sol out of line, then back into line.
When Sol and Lune line up, the coin shines: Sol's Tarnish falls asleep and Lune's wakes up.
